1.name: Awaken
1.description: Awakens all sleeping members of the party.

2.name: Pandora's box
2.description: Opens a dimensional rift and randomly pulls an entity into your reality.
2.explanation:
Chances:
30%: receive 1-100 gold
30%: receive a random L1 item
20%: random L1 monster appears
5%: receive 101 - 200 gold
5%: receive a random L2 item
5%: random L2 monster appears
4%: receive 1000 - 10000 gold
1%: Dragon Lord (ID 83) appears

3.name: Elemental Arrow
3.description: Does 8 damage of a random elemental type to one monster.

4.name: First Aid
4.description: Heals one character for 6 hit points.

5.name: Flying Fist
5.description: Does 6 physical damage to one monster.

6.name: Light
6.description: Lights up dark dungeons and caves.

7.name: Cure Wounds
7.description: Heals one character for 15 hit points.

8.name: Energy Blast
8.description: Does 2-6 energy damage per caster level to one monster.

9.name: Revitalize
9.description: Removes the "Weak" status from one character.

10.name: Sparks
10.description: Does 2 magic damage per caster level to a group of monsters.

11.name: Suppress Poison
11.description: Reduces "Poisoned" status on one character to minimum.

12.name: Pain
12.description: Does 8 physical damage to a group of monsters.

13.name: Dimensional Phasing
13.description: Put all monsters in a 4 field radius in a different dimensional phase for 5 turns.
13.explanation:
1) Stop all movement/animation for monsters in radius
2) Color all monsters in purple and make the half transparent
3) Monster do not/move attack and also cannot be attacked or take damage of any kind.
4) After 5 turns return monsters to normal

14.name: Toxic Cloud
14.description: Does 10 poison damage to a group of monsters.

15.name: Acid Stream
15.description: Does 25 acid damage to one monster.

16.name: Jump
16.description: Moves the party two spaces ahead

17.name: Protection from Elements
17.description: Gives the party damage reduction to either fire, cold, magic or acid.

18.name: Suppress Madness
18.description: Reduces "Crazy" status on one character to minimum.

19.name: Turn Undead
19.description: Damages or destroys a group of undead monsters.

20.name: Stone Skin
20.description: Gives a character +1 AC per caster's level, but halves the target's speed for 12h

21.name: Levitate
21.description: Lets the party levitate to avoid pit traps for 4 hours

22.name: Gravity
22.description: Pulls all monsters in a 4 field radius around the party, if there is a way.

23.name: Suppress Disease
23.description: Reduces "Diseased" status on one character to minimum.

24.name: Wizard Eye
24.description: Displays a map of the party's surroundings for 8h
24.explanation:
1) Shows the level incl. The not explored areas
2) Shows traps, if crow is mascot
3) Does not show monsters (see "36 - Detect monster")

25.name: Rage
25.description: Gives a character +1 damage per caster's level, but halves the target's armor for 12h

26.name: Identify Monster
26.description: Shows the hit points, AC, attacks per round, and special abilities of monsters in combat range.

27.name: Nature's Cure
27.description: Heals one character for 25 hit points.

28.name: Power Cure
28.description: Heals one character for 2â€“12 hit points per caster level.

29.name: Frost Bite
29.description: Deals 35 cold damage to one monster.

30.name: Dimensional Rift
30.description: Target Character cannot attack or be attacked for 5 turns. If party moves the spell is cancelled.
30.explanation:
1) Works similar like 13- Dimensional phasing, but on own character
2) color character in purple
3) Character does not receive any damage, nor does he have a turn
4) End spell after 5 turns or if party moves a field

31.name: Immobilize
31.description: Makes a monster unabled to move for 3 turns. Each monster can only be immobilized once.
31.explanation:
1) The monster in front of the party cannot move. 
2) It receives damage as usual and can attack, if party is in front of it or if it has range capabilties

32.name: Lloyd's Beacon
32.explanation:
1) When cast the player select between "Set" and "Return"
2) "Set" remembers the current position
3)  "Return" moves the party back to the position
4) Spell is cross-world (e.g. save a position in town and return to it from a dungeon)

33.name: Power Shield
33.description: Reduces incoming damage for the party by 10% for 1h.
33.explanation: Will show a power shield icon in the top right. Use a dummy until final icon is provided

34.name: Walk on Water
34.description: Allows the party to walk on water for 4h

36.name: Detect Monster
36.description: Shows monsters on mini map for 8h
36.explanation: Shows monsters on mini map (does not reveal anything unexplored - this is done via 24-wizard's eye)

37.name: Lightning Bolt
37.description: Does 4-6 magic damage per caster level to a group of monsters.

38.name: Acid Spray
38.description: Does 15 acid damage to all monsters.

39.name: Cold Ray
39.description: Does 2-4 cold damage per caster level to all monsters.

41.name: Clumsy
41.description: Makes the monster in front of you clumsy, thus lowering ist chance to hit you.
41.explanation:
1) Monster in front of the player rolls a dice when attacking.
2) it has a 10% chance that the attack does not take place. Otherwise continue with the standard process for attacks
3) Effect does not stack and stays with the monster until it dies

42.name: Time Distortion
42.explanation: Finds the closest area to party's current location, where they are out of reach of monster attacks

43.name: Finger of Death
43.description: 50% chance to kill a low level monster instantly, which is next to you.
43.explanation:
1) Only works on monsters adjacent to the party and only monsters the party is looking at
2) 50% chance that a L1/L2 monster is killed instantly (L1/L2 refers to the monsters treasure level)

44.name: Fireball
44.description: Does 3-7 fire damage per caster level to a group of monsters.

45.name: Nature's Gate
45.description: Teleports the party to an another biome
45.explanation:
1) selects a random biome (explored or unexplored), different from the current one
2) places the party in a place, where no monsters are in attack range
3) party must only be placed on freely accessible areas

46.name: Communion
46.description: 50% chance to remove curses from a character

47.name: Teleport
47.description: Moves party up to nine spaces.

49.name: Deadly Swarm
49.description: Does 40 physical damage to a group of monsters
49.explanation: Deals 40 physical damage to all monsters in direct line in front of the party

50.name: Dragon Breath
50.description: Hits all monsters for 5 damage per caster level.

51.name: Fiery Flail
51.description: Does 100 fire damage to one monster.

52.name: Super Shelter
52.description: Lets party rest in unsafe areas.
52.explanation:
1) Party can rest, even if monsters are nearby
2) Monsters do not attack party during the rest

54.name: Sanity
54.description: Removes the crazy status from a character.

55.name: Combine
55.description: Combine 3 items of the same type to the next higher material level.
55.explanation:
1) after casting, player must select a character
2) Characters inventory is opened
3) If character does not have 3 items of the same kind and material (e.g. 3 wooden short swords) the spell is cancelled (mana is still consumed)
4) if at least one valid combination is found, player selects the 3 valid items and clicks a "Combine" button (button is only active, if combination is correct). Put an "Abort" button next to combine
5) On successful combine replace the 3 items with 1 item of the same type, but 1 material level better. If combining rings, the ring will be 1 level better as well

56.name: Half For Me
56.description: Heals one character, but damages the caster for half the hit points healed
56.explanation: 1) Heals target character to the maximum or to the extend that caster has 1 HP left (e.g. target character missed 30HP, character has 11 HP> max 10HP can be taken from caster, meaning the target is healed by 20 HP)

57.name: Emergency rations
57.description: Creates enough food for the party to rest.
57.explanation: Creates 1 food for the party, but cannot exceed 1 food.

58.name: Duplication
58.description: 50% chance that item is duplicated, 25% chance that item is destroyed

59.name: Disintegrate
59.description: Does 250 magic damage to one monster.

60.name: Moon Ray
60.description: Does 100 magic damage to all monsters and heals party
60.explanation: Heals each party member by up to 50 HP

61.name: Stone to Flesh
61.description: Removes the "Petrified" status from one character

62.name: Etherealise
62.description: Allows party to walk through doors or brittle walls

63.name: Dancing Sword
63.description: Does 6-14 physical damage per caster level to a group of monsters

64.name: Mass Distortion
64.description: 20% chance to damage a group of monsters for half their hit points
64.explanation:
1) All monsters in a straight line in front of the party roll a dice individually
2) with a 20% chance they lose 50% of their health
3) Does not work on L5 monsters

66.name: Town Portal
66.description: Teleports party to any visited town. Can only be used outside battle.
66.explanation: Functions like a regular town portal.

67.name: Transform Ring
67.description: Randomly changes a ring to another one of the same level, with a 25% risk of the ring being destroyed.

68.name: Mega Volts
68.description: Does 200 magical damage to a group of monsters

69.name: Holy Word
69.description: Severely damages or destroys undead monster
69.explanation:
1) Directly reduces the HP of an undead monster by 150 HP
2) Undead monsters with max HP > 600 instantly lose 25% of their max HP

70.name: Resurrect
70.description: Revives a rotten character, but permanently reduces their Endurance by 1 and caster magically ages by 5 years.

71.name: Sun Ray
71.description: Does 200 fire damage to one monster.

72.name: Meteor Shower
72.description: Does 100 fire damage to all monsters.

73.name: Prismatic Light
73.description: Hits all monsters. 90-100 random damage effect.

74.name: Incinerate
74.description: Does 250-500 fire damage to one monster

75.name: Elemental Storm
75.description: Does 150 fire, ice or acid damage to all monsters

76.name: Star Burst
76.description: Does 200 energy damage to all monsters in a 3 field radius.

77.name: Implosion
77.description: Does 1000 energy damage to one monster

78.name: Divine Intervention
78.description: All party members are cured of all statuses (except "Eradicated") and restored to full hit points, but the caster ages 5 years.
